nodes.label: Sincronizar Divisas (GitHub Actions workflow)
nodes.rationale: Replaces the manual '⟳ Sincronizar con...' button removed from Actualizar.tsx on 31-jul-2026. Vercel Hobby (this project's free plan) only allows cron jobs once per day, so automation runs here instead of on Vercel: every 30 minutes, all 9 currencies, each step independent (continue-on-error) so one failing source doesn't block the rest.

nodes.label: Sincronizar Titulares (GitHub Actions workflow)
nodes.rationale: Replaces the manual '⟳ Sincronizar (Finnhub)' / '🌐 Traducir pendientes' buttons removed from Titulares.tsx on 31-jul-2026. Vercel Hobby's free plan doesn't allow cron more frequent than daily, so this runs every 10 minutes: fetches new Finnhub headlines and translates any pending ones.

nodes.label: USD currency pipeline (~43 indicators)
nodes.rationale: The original currency, automated via FRED; best composite Score coverage and most complete subcomponent data (GDP-by-component via BEA NIPA, PCE + Personal Income/Spending subcomponents).

nodes.label: EUR currency pipeline (21 Eurozone + 18 DE/FR indicators)
nodes.rationale: Automated via FRED plus Eurostat SDMX directly for HICP flash→final and GDP-by-component; separate Alemania/Francia (DE/FR) country pages added after the Excel migration since the user wanted German/French internals broken out, not just Eurozone aggregates.
nodes.norm_label: eur currency pipeline (21 eurozone + 18 de/fr indicators)

nodes.label: GBP currency pipeline (16 indicators, mostly manual)
nodes.rationale: Mostly manual because the old ONS API was decommissioned Nov-2024 and its replacement (api.beta.ons.gov.uk) has key datasets explicitly frozen (e.g. cpih01 alert 'no longer being updated'); only the BoE policy rate and trade balance are automated.
nodes.norm_label: gbp currency pipeline (16 indicators, mostly manual)

nodes.label: CAD currency pipeline (17 indicators, 11 automated)
nodes.rationale: The currency with the most data-convention lessons: StatCan publishes multiple valid series for the 'same' concept (SA vs NSA CPI, multiple 'core CPI' definitions) that are not interchangeable, and matching the user's real reference source (not just the official press release) was required to pick the right one.

nodes.label: AUD currency pipeline (20 indicators, 16 automated)
nodes.rationale: Inflation deliberately uses the quarterly 'pre-October 2025' CPI base instead of the new full-monthly CPI, because that is the release the user's reference calendar tracks — both are live, parallel official releases, not an old vs new series.

nodes.label: NZD currency pipeline (14 indicators, 6 automated)
nodes.rationale: Least automated non-USD currency: rbnz.govt.nz is entirely Cloudflare-blocked for any automated fetch, HLFS employment data ships only as a ~400MB unzipped CSV, and trade balance is XLSX-only — all left manual by design rather than risking a fragile parser.

nodes.label: JPY currency pipeline (16 indicators, 12 automated)
nodes.rationale: Best-automated non-USD currency at the time it was added, using the undocumented but keyless 'e-Stat Dashboard API' (distinct from the appId-gated main e-Stat API) plus BOJ and Japan Customs CSVs, none of which are blocked unlike rbnz.govt.nz.

nodes.label: CHF currency pipeline (16 indicators, 9 automated)
nodes.rationale: Only non-USD currency with both Business and Consumer Confidence automated (KOF Barometer v2 + SECO index), using an undocumented SNB Data Portal API and a SECO CSV feed found by scraping seco.admin.ch HTML rather than any published API docs.

nodes.label: CNY currency pipeline (13 indicators, 13/13 automated — reference/risk-proxy currency)
nodes.rationale: Added at explicit user request as a risk-proxy currency, deliberately excluding Central Banks, Confidence, Employment and composite Score. The only currency whose sole automated source is an unofficial third-party aggregator (chinadata.live), because the official NBS query API WAF-blocks non-Chinese IPs.
nodes.norm_label: cny currency pipeline (13 indicators, 13/13 automated — reference/risk-proxy currency)

nodes.label: HIKMAN ENDÓGENO dashboard
nodes.rationale: Web dashboard replacing per-currency Excel macro-analysis sheets. Core design idea: a stale or miscalculated datapoint must never go unnoticed, hence freshness badges on every card and the project-wide habit of verifying each series against a real reference source (official communiqué or the user's own market calendar) before automating it.

nodes.label: Multi-currency architecture pattern
nodes.rationale: Fixed pattern repeated for every new currency: one global currency selector rather than separate routes; a single INDICATORS[] namespaced by id prefix plus an optional `currency` field; ScoreRow follows the same pattern; Supabase tables are shared across currencies (separation purely by id prefix, never reuse another currency's id); PMI always goes under 'crecimiento'; a currency need not implement all 6 sections — Layout.tsx/Dashboard.tsx generically hide any section/Score/Banqueros link with zero indicators.

nodes.label: Why api/*-sync.ts duplicate src/data/ mappings
nodes.rationale: Vercel bundles each /api serverless function separately and fails to trace imports crossing into /src (runtime ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND), so every serverless function must be 100% self-contained. Changing a mapping requires touching both files: the /src copy only feeds the UI source badge, the /api copy is what actually performs the sync.

nodes.label: GitHub Actions scheduled cron never fired on its own
nodes.rationale: After merging both workflows to the default branch, `list_workflow_runs` showed exactly 1 run each (the manual workflow_dispatch test) after 1h29min, when ~9 (titulares) and ~3 (currencies) scheduled runs were expected — a known but undocumented GitHub behavior where newly created scheduled workflows can take hours to 'wake up'. Not confirmed by end of session whether it started firing on its own later.
nodes.norm_label: github actions scheduled cron never fired on its own

nodes.label: Backup sync Routine (trig_01VigD4t2wgyxh8YCAYDqtg1)
nodes.rationale: Hourly Claude Code Remote trigger (create_new_session_on_fire) calling the same 11 sync endpoints as an independent safety net, until the native GitHub Actions cron is confirmed to fire reliably on its own — should not be deleted without first checking `list_workflow_runs` for `event: schedule`.

nodes.label: ScorePanel <select> ±2 range constraint
nodes.rationale: Source Excel valuations can use different max scales per row (1, 2, 3, or 4), but ScorePanel.tsx's <select> only offers 5 integer options (-2..2); any out-of-range value fails to match any <option> and the dropdown shows the wrong option even though the stored TOTAL is correct. Fix: proportionally rescale any out-of-range valuation to ±2 when building scoreSeed*.ts — an accepted trade-off where the app's TOTAL no longer replicates the Excel TOTAL exactly.

nodes.label: Self-hosting central-banker photos instead of hotlinking
nodes.rationale: Hotlinking official bank-website photos returned HTTP 200 via curl but rendered as broken images in real Chrome, because banks send `Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy: same-origin` (curl doesn't evaluate CORP, browsers enforce it). Fix: download and re-serve from public/bankers/*.jpg on the same domain, same pattern already used for favicon.svg.
nodes.norm_label: self-hosting central-banker photos instead of hotlinking

nodes.label: Preliminar/Final release-stage badge (IndicatorMeta.releaseStage)
nodes.rationale: Badge marking indicators where the source publishes the same datapoint in two distinct passes and the dashboard knows for certain which one it tracks (e.g. flash PMI vs S&P Global final PMI). Deliberately NOT used for indicators with gradual revision of the same series point (any GDP, EUR HICP once flash→final was automated) because there the 'stage' changes per data point rather than being a fixed property of the indicator.

nodes.label: EUR HICP flash→final automation via Eurostat prc_hicp_fpd
nodes.rationale: Eurostat dataset prc_hicp_fpd separates the FLS (flash) release from the FIN (final) release with m/m and a/a rates already calculated, replacing the old FRED mapping (~1 month lag behind flash). Upsert is keyed by period date, so the FIN release automatically overwrites the FLS value for the same point with no manual intervention.
nodes.norm_label: eur hicp flash→final automation via eurostat prc_hicp_fpd

nodes.label: EUR GDP-by-component automation via namq_10_gdp (unit=CON_PPCH_PRE)
nodes.rationale: The same Eurostat dataset that already supplied GDP level exposes unit=CON_PPCH_PRE with growth contribution per component pre-calculated by Eurostat — no need to derive from levels (unlike the failed CAD attempt) — enabling automated Consumption/Investment/Government/Net-Exports with 17 quarters backfilled.

nodes.label: GDP subcomponent redesign (Consumo/Inversión/Gasto Público/Exportaciones Netas) across all 9 currencies
nodes.rationale: Replaced the empty 'Demanda Interna/Externa' placeholders with the classic C+I+G+NX breakdown plus Prices (deflator). Coverage varies sharply by country depending on whether the statistics office publishes a pre-calculated growth contribution: USD/EUR/AUD got full automation with backfill, JPY only Net-Exports, CNY reparented to YoY with Government intentionally blank, and GBP/CAD/NZD/CHF stayed fully manual after derivation-from-levels attempts failed to match official figures.
nodes.norm_label: gdp subcomponent redesign (consumo/inversion/gasto publico/exportaciones netas) across all 9 currencies

nodes.label: Panel de Control page (/panel-control)
nodes.rationale: Global, currency-independent page combining a scrolling headline ticker (MarqueeTicker), a per-currency bias card, and document-upload lists for reports/mentor notes. A planned market-indicators panel went through four TradingView-widget iterations plus a custom FRED/Frankfurter/Finnhub build, then was abandoned entirely at the user's explicit request ('no me gusta como está quedando').

nodes.label: Currency Bias feature (CurrencyBiasCard)
nodes.rationale: Hawkish/Neutro Alcista/Neutro/Neutro Bajista/Dovish badge per currency, editable at any time — not tied to the weekly rollover button, since the user wanted to change sentiment mid-week when a datapoint moves it. Rollover freezes the current week's reasons into `previous_reasons`/history without resetting the badge level.

nodes.label: Titulares (headlines) feature
nodes.rationale: Global headline cards with red/orange/gray impact badges, manual entry with mandatory currency/asset tags, and a 'pin' flag feeding the Panel de Control ticker. Synced from Finnhub's forex category, filtered to G10+CNY+bonds/equities by keyword classification (HIGH_IMPACT_KEYWORDS/CURRENCY_KEYWORDS).

nodes.label: Forex Factory CDN URL change broke headlines sync
nodes.rationale: Forex Factory dropped the 'cdn-' prefix from its calendar JSON CDN without notice (DNS stopped resolving for cdn-nfs.faireconomy.media) — the same 'API/CDN changed silently' pattern already documented for GBP/CAD/AUD/RBNZ. Fixed, then the user asked to remove Forex Factory entirely since scheduled economic-calendar events aren't 'headlines' in the intended sense.
nodes.norm_label: forex factory cdn url change broke headlines sync

nodes.label: Automatic headline translation via MyMemory
nodes.rationale: Finnhub headlines (English) get an italic Spanish translation appended below the original rather than replacing it, to avoid losing trading nuance. Uses the free MyMemory API; fails gracefully per-headline; a separate /api/translate-headlines endpoint backfills up to 200 pre-existing untranslated rows per run, excluding manual/imported entries already in Spanish.

nodes.label: Renta Variable (equities) feature (/renta-variable)
nodes.rationale: After evaluating massive.com (real-time but paid) and Finnhub free tier (US-only), settled on Finnhub for USD stocks plus unofficial Yahoo Finance for all indices and non-US equities. /api/equities-quotes.ts deliberately does not persist to Supabase since prices are fetched fresh per page load, not stored as a macro time series. Handles London Stock Exchange prices quoted in pence (GBp/GBX) by dividing by 100.

nodes.label: Subcomponent modal UX (SubcomponentModal.tsx + groupByParent)
nodes.rationale: Replaced USD ISM's inline accordion with a reusable modal, generalized via IndicatorMeta.parentId + groupByParent so any indicator's children (PMI, GDP) can use it across all currencies. Later generalized further into SectionGrid.tsx (not just Crecimiento.tsx) to avoid a coverage gap that would otherwise have affected the new PCE subcomponents.

nodes.label: Migration from HIKMAN CAPITAL SISTEMA 2.0.xlsx
nodes.rationale: Imported Bias (SESGOS), Reasons (MOTIVOS), Headlines (TITULARES) and manual economic indicators (DATOS_ECO, only 59 of 265 rows matched an existing catalog entry) from the prior Excel workflow. Required widening CurrencyBias.previous into a full BiasSnapshot[] history and BiasReason.color into the full 5-level scale, since the spreadsheet was richer than the dashboard's first data model.

nodes.label: Hikman Capital brand identity (logo/watermark)
nodes.rationale: User-uploaded AI-generated PNG mockup processed into transparent logo-icon.png/logo-full.png/favicon.png via an HSV-saturation alpha threshold in Python/Pillow, since the source had no real transparency. favicon.png replaced favicon.svg in index.html. Caused a CSS stacking-context bug: the page's fixed watermark was hidden behind Layout.tsx's root div (positioned, no own stacking context) until the `isolate` class was added.

nodes.label: chinadata.live aggregator repeatedly lags weeks/months behind NBS releases
nodes.rationale: CNY's sole automated data source (an unofficial third-party aggregator, chosen because the official NBS query API WAF-blocks non-Chinese IPs) has twice fallen ~1-2 months behind on 8-10 of its 13 series simultaneously while PMI stayed current. Each time required manually verifying and pushing corrected values from NBS/GACC press releases directly to Supabase; flagged as the dashboard's most fragile automated data point, with a stats.gov.cn press-release scraper suggested as a fallback if it recurs.
nodes.norm_label: chinadata.live aggregator repeatedly lags weeks/months behind nbs releases

nodes.label: stop-hook-git-check.sh 'Unverified' commit warning
nodes.rationale: Merge commits made via GitHub's PR API/web button get committer noreply@github.com, which GitHub labels 'Unverified' — purely cosmetic, doesn't affect code or deploy. User explicitly asked not to rewrite these commits with --amend/force-push to 'fix' it.

nodes.label: FRED API (Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis)
nodes.norm_label: fred api (federal reserve bank of st. louis)

nodes.label: Eurostat SDMX API
nodes.rationale: Path-based positional keys (/data/{dataset}/{freq}.{unit}.{item}.{geo}) are reliable; loose query-string filters (geo=&lastTimePeriod=N) can silently be ignored and return the full 70+MB dataset.

nodes.label: USD Macro — Seguimiento Fundamental (README project description)
nodes.rationale: Describes a single-currency (USD) dashboard replacing an Excel sheet, with a stated plan to later add EUR/GBP/NZD/AUD/CHF/JPY/CAD 'once USD is sólido'.
nodes.norm_label: usd macro — seguimiento fundamental (readme project description)
